verdict.rationale: PayPal publishes an official Agent Toolkit library on GitHub in TypeScript and Python that wraps its APIs as pre-built functions for major agent frameworks. It also ships an official `@paypal/mcp` npm package and official OpenAPI specs with a documented codegen workflow for generating API clients. However, the evidence never documents general-purpose official server or client SDKs for the REST APIs; client code is shown as generated from specs rather than shipped as maintained SDK packages. Missing for 10: documented official general-purpose SDKs across languages with install and usage guides, SDK reference docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
